_comment: Rebuilds examples/channel-demo.dwg. Input: a metric drawing that already carries the @C3DF-* styles the examples use (section view @C3DF-SimpleGrid / @C3DF-NoGrid, section @C3DF-GroundLine, shape @C3DF-CutFill, code set @C3DF-Dredge, profile view @C3DF-ProfileView + @C3DF-ProfileBands, profiles @C3DF-GroundProfile / @C3DF-DesignProfile, alignment @C3DF-Centerline, sample line @C3DF-SampleLine, group plot @C3DF-PrintStyle-A3, QTO criteria @C3DF-CutFill). The shipped demo was seeded from the maintainer's own style library (examples/private, not in git); channel-demo.dwg itself is the public copy of those styles.

ops._comment: 1:500 - the usual sheet scale for channel sections (text 2.5 mm = 1.25 m)
leftover check: every style the examples use must be present under its @C3DF-* name
